provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: 〜までだ／〜までのことだ announces the fallback the speaker will simply take when the preferred route closes, so it attaches to a dictionary-form verb and typically follows a conditional: 駄目ならやり直すまでだ. The other lanes are ranges, not resolutions: how far an action extends (駅まで歩く), the stretch until an event happens (雨がやむまで), and a cap on an allowance (一人二枚まで). The ta-form 〜たまでだ downplays a past act as having no further motive: 聞かれたから答えたまでだ.

examples.ruby: 駄目[だめ]なら、また一[いち]からやり直[なお]すまでだ。
examples.english: If it doesn't work out, I'll simply start over from scratch.

examples.ruby: 誰[だれ]も来[こ]ないなら、一人[ひとり]で始[はじ]めるまでのことだ。
examples.english: If nobody shows up, I'll just get started on my own, that's all.

examples.ruby: 終電[しゅうでん]を逃[のが]したなら、歩[ある]いて帰[かえ]るまでだ。
examples.english: If I've missed the last train, I'll simply walk home, that's all.
